root_cause.text: Standalone IPv6 nexthop objects on the loopback interface are misclassified as reject routes in `fib6_nh_init()` due to reliance on `fib6_is_reject()`'s device-based heuristic instead of checking the `RTF_REJECT` flag, causing `fib_nh_common_init()` to be skipped and `nhc_pcpu_rth_output` to remain uninitialized.
root_cause.evidence: The patch modifies `net/ipv6/route.c` in `fib6_nh_init()` by replacing the condition `fib6_is_reject(cfg->fc_flags, dev, addr_type)` with `cfg->fc_flags & RTF_REJECT`, ensuring only explicitly marked reject routes skip `fib_nh_common_init()`; the CVE description confirms this misclassification leaves `nhc_pcpu_rth_output` unallocated, leading to a NULL pointer dereference in `__mkroute_output()`.
